newsitem.title: USA: Belden Inc to purchase Intech Cable.
newsitem.headline: Belden Inc to purchase Intech Cable.

text.p: Belden Inc said Tuesday it has reached an agreement to purchase substantially all the assets of Intech Cable Inc for cash.
Intech manufactures and markets specialty wire and cable and had 1995 revenues of about $34 million. It operates facilities in Hudson, Massachusetts and Charlotte, North Carolina, the companies said.
Its principal market is the telecommunication industry where it primarily serves the regional Bell operating companies, independent telephone companies and telecommunication distributors.
Belden designs, manufactures and markets wire, cable and cord products for electronic and electrical markets.
Belden shares closed down 5/8 at 30-3/8 Tuesday.
